_comment: intro = story cards shown once per session after ENTER THE MANOR (click/Space advances, Esc skips). lines = cutscenes keyed by event; each plays at most once per run and freezes play until the last line is dismissed (click/Space/Enter advances, Esc skips). A line is [speaker, text]. Speaker colours live in speakers; display names in names.
intro:
Blackglass Manor. Midnight.

At dawn Lord Oswald sails for the coast with a ledger of every name he ever sold. Yours was one of them.

Slip into any shadow close by. Even a guard's.
Put out the study lamp. Reach Oswald.

One strike. No witnesses.

mission_start: The kitchen garden. Their shadows will carry me in.
study: Every name in that ledger paid for this house.
Then yours will be the last.
